qualification: Three-pair AB/BA/AB same-OS sampled-memory diagnostic. Does not replace the original C7 protocol, oracle, endpoints, present or peak-memory qualifications.

receiptIdentityPolicy.processStartedUtc: Original parent .NET observation; never overwritten with the child's value.
receiptIdentityPolicy.parentObservedProcessStartedUtc: Exact duplicate of the original parent processStartedUtc observation.
receiptIdentityPolicy.canonicalProcessStartedUtc: For the host only, the child's unmodified ready UTC string, assigned only after exact launch/ready/native identity equality; null for sampler receipts.
receiptIdentityPolicy.hostReadyIdentityValidated: True only for a host whose launch observation, ready observation and ready payload match exact PID and all native identity fields.
receiptIdentityPolicy.nativeIdentityAtLaunch: Captured immediately after process start, before reading the parent .NET UTC start observation.
receiptIdentityPolicy.nativeIdentityAtReady: Fresh native observation before accepting host ready; null for sampler receipts.
receiptIdentityPolicy.windows: Require exact PID and creation FILETIME equality across launch/ready/payload; parent and canonical child UTC must also be exactly equal.
receiptIdentityPolicy.linux: Require exact PID, /proc/stat field22 start ticks and boot ID across launch/ready/payload. Parent/child .NET UTC conversions are retained independently and are not compared with tolerance or rounding.

sequence: host initializes matching empty chart, line series, axes, fonts, native software surface and RTB; writes host/ready.json before DatasetFactory/source construction
sampler checks native process identity; opens evidence and obtains first process sample (also Linux smaps sample); atomic control/sampler-ready.json status=ready
host validates sampler-ready; records samplerReadyObservedQpc then workStart; generation -> sourceApply -> prepare -> record -> controlledRaster -> hit
host records managed endpoints and guards, writes host/work-complete.json, retaining source/chart/RTB roots and holding the process open
sampler reads work-complete and takes terminal process sample plus Linux smaps sample; flushes evidence/result.json then atomic control/sampler-complete.json status=completed
runner waits for successful sampler exit then writes control/release.json status=release
host validates both controls, writes host/raw.json and exits; runner retains both process receipts
pathContract: Campaign run paths are relative to campaign.json parent; host and sampler denote directories. All attempts, errors, timeout evidence and stdout/stderr receipts are retained. No automatic retry.
measurementContract: Windows current private commit and working set at 20ms; Linux status RSS/HWM at 20ms and smaps RSS/PSS/private-resident/swap at 100ms. Keep measurement kinds separate. Use same-kind matched pair maxObserved(full)-maxObserved(empty) without clipping negative deltas. Source allocation and managed evidence remain included in full process totals. No forced GC, accurate-native subtraction, GPU, instantaneous-peak or original C7 timing claim.
